import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import numpy as np
x = np.linspace(0, 10, 200) y = np.sin(x)
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4)) plt.plot(x, y, label=“sin(x)”) plt.title(“A Simple Sine Curve”) plt.legend() plt.grid(True) plt.show()




Kleist, Linda, Peter Kramer, and Christian Rieck. 2024. “On the Connectivity of the Flip Graph of Plane Spanning Paths.” https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.03912.
